title: feat: add redirectBack utility
body:
## Summary

Closes #642

Adds `redirectBack(event, opts?)` — redirects the client to the previous page using the `referer` header.

```ts
app.post("/submit", (event) => {
  // process form...
  return redirectBack(event, { fallback: "/form" });
});
```

### Safety

- Only redirects to **same-origin** referer URLs (prevents open redirect)
- Falls back to `opts.fallback` (default `"/"`) when referer is missing or cross-origin
- Invalid referer URLs are caught and fall back safely

### API

```ts
redirectBack(event: H3Event, opts?: {
  fallback?: string;  // default: "/"
  status?: number;    // default: 302
}): HTTPResponse
```

Reuses the existing `redirect()` function internally.

## Test plan

- [x] Redirects to same-origin referer
- [x] Falls back on cross-origin referer
- [x] Falls back when no referer header
- [x] Defaults fallback to "/"
- [x] All tests pass in both web and node modes (8/8)
- [x] Package exports snapshot updated

feat: add redirectBack utility

Redirect the client back to the previous page using the referer header.
Falls back to a configurable URL (default "/") when:
- No referer header is present
- Referer is a different origin (prevents open redirect)

Usage:
  app.post("/submit", (event) => redirectBack(event, { fallback: "/form" }));

Closes #642
